title: An incomplete template bound is malformed annotation syntax

ground_truth.statement: A template as/of bound requires a type following the keyword; @template T as has none. Runtime confirms that this is annotation syntax, not invalid PHP. The original SKIPPED label is not treated as a current expectation.

allowed.reason: The class parser reports the same missing bound type already identified by invalid-docblock at this exact site.

provenance.note: Read the concatenated source string in full. Re-derived its incomplete @template T as annotation. Although upstream marks the lead SKIPPED, the malformed grammar has a meaningful measurement today.

notes: Measured, not disabled or deferred. PHPStan reports phpDoc.parseError at line 4. Mago reports invalid-docblock and a duplicate class-parser malformed-docblock-comment there. Psalm 6.20.0 emits nothing, retained as a syntax-policy FN against the documented bound grammar. The upstream SKIPPED label does not justify dropping this runnable comparison.
